name: ESSAI 2026
venue: European Summer School on Artificial Intelligence, Vienna, Austria
description: The 2026 European Summer School on Artificial Intelligence (ESSAI) takes place in Vienna, Austria from 6 to 10 July. It offers a one‑week program of introductory and advanced AI courses, tutorials, and tracks on Bilateral AI and Digital Humanism, targeting PhD students, young researchers, and senior scholars. The school also provides networking opportunities, a reception at Vienna City Hall, and is co‑located with the 5th ACM Europe Digital Humanism Summer School.

name: OpenEuroLLM Winter School
description: The 2026 Winter School on Multilinguality in LLM Development and Evaluation is organized by the Nordic Language Processing Laboratory and the OpenEuroLLM project in Norway. It targets NLP researchers, especially those from EuroHPC consortium countries and doctoral students, and focuses on multilingual large language models, their evaluation, data curation, and open‑science practices. The three‑day event takes place at the Skeikampen conference hotel north of Oslo and includes technical talks, hands‑on sessions, and a bus transfer from Oslo Airport, with no participation fee.

name: Probabilistic AI School
description: The Probabilistic AI School 2026 is a summer school taking place in Vilnius, Lithuania. It aims to provide an inclusive educational environment covering state‑of‑the‑art machine learning and artificial intelligence topics. The programme welcomes enthusiasts, students, academics and industry professionals to learn and network.

name: BMVA Computer Vision Summer School
description: The 29th BMVA Computer Vision Summer School will be held at Durham University in Durham, England, UK. It offers an intensive week of lectures and lab sessions covering a wide range of topics in computer vision, delivered by leading researchers from the UK and abroad. The programme features daily oral talks and hands‑on sessions designed for students and professionals seeking advanced knowledge and networking opportunities in the field.

name: Oxford Machine Learning Summer School 2026
venue: Oxford Machine Learning School, Oxford, United Kingdom
description: OxML 2026 was a machine‑learning school organized by the Oxford Machine Learning School, offering three advanced programmes in online and hybrid formats. The programmes covered practical AI model building (MLx Cases), applications of representation learning and generative AI in health and biomedical sciences (MLx Health & Bio), and the latest advances in representation learning and frontier AI models (MLx Representation Learning & Gen AI). Participants could access recordings and programme materials through the Elandi learning dashboard after the event.

name: Robotics, Perception and Learning (RPL) Summer School
venue: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden
description: The RPL Summer School 2026 is a six‑day event for doctoral and postdoctoral researchers organized by the Department for Robotics, Perception and Learning at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, Sweden. It covers a broad spectrum of topics such as machine learning, computer vision, robotics, human‑robot interaction, planning and decision making, and combines keynote talks, industry panels, student presentations, and open brainstorming sessions to foster new collaborations. The program is hosted at the Happy Tammsvik resort, providing participants with nature‑based activities, accommodation, meals and a relaxed environment for networking and idea generation.

name: Machine Learning Crash Course at MALGA
description: The MLCC2026 Summer School – Machine Learning Crash Course – provides an introduction to fundamental machine‑learning concepts and algorithms. It is aimed at undergraduate and graduate students, as well as professionals, and is open to participants from any university after a selection process. The five‑day in‑person program in Genoa combines theoretical lectures with hands‑on lab sessions and includes a final test consisting of notebook work and a report.

name: UK Robotics Summer School
venue: National Robotarium, Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
description: The UK Robotics Summer School 2026 is a five‑day event held in Edinburgh, organized by the Edinburgh Centre for Robotics, Heriot‑Watt University and the National Robotarium. It offers expert lectures, tutorials and industry talks covering bio‑inspired robotics, healthcare robotics, generative AI, safe AI and real‑world applications, with hands‑on experience on state‑of‑the‑art robotic systems. The programme targets master’s‑level students and industry practitioners, providing networking opportunities and a special dinner.

name: International Summer School for Advanced Studies on Biometrics, Behavior, and Vision
description: The 2027 Biometrics Summer School takes place at Hotel Dei Pini in Porto Conte near Alghero, Sardinia, Italy. It focuses on the impact of agentic AI and vision foundation models on biometrics and human recognition, covering topics such as machine learning, image understanding, neuroscience, robotics, and digital forensics. The program is aimed at PhD students, post‑docs, researchers, forensic examiners and professionals, offering intensive lectures, keynote talks, and optional videoconference participation with scholarships available.

name: Winter School on Ethical, Legal, and Societal (ELS) aspects of AI and AS at Umeå University
description: The Winter School on Ethical, Legal, and Societal aspects of AI and Autonomous Systems brings together researchers and students to discuss responsible AI. It offers lectures, multidisciplinary hands‑on training, a poster session and a social program to foster networking and professional exchange. The three‑day event takes place at Umeå University in Sweden from 11 to 13 March 2026.

name: Winter School on Social Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Multimedia (SoRAIM 2026)
description: The ACM Europe Winter School SoRAIM’27 focuses on social robotics, artificial intelligence, and multimedia. It targets PhD students and early‑career researchers, offering lectures, hands‑on sessions, and informal networking in a mountain setting. The program aims to foster cross‑disciplinary exchange among experts in computer vision, speech processing, affective computing, and human‑robot interaction.

name: Northern Lights Deep Learning Winter School
venue: UiT – The Arctic University of Norway, Tromsø, Norway
description: The 2027 Winter School on Deep Learning is part of the Northern Lights Deep Learning Conference and will be held in Tromsø, Norway. It runs from 11 January to 15 January 2027 and is organized by UiT – The Arctic University of Norway. The school offers participants intensive lectures and hands‑on sessions covering state‑of‑the‑art deep‑learning methods such as image classification, object detection, segmentation, time‑series prediction and speech recognition.

name: Annual Nepal AI School (ANAIS)
description: The 7th Annual Nepal AI School (ANAIS) is an 11‑day intensive in‑person program held at Kathmandu World School in Kathmandu, Nepal. It offers lectures, labs, and project work covering fundamentals to advanced topics such as geometric deep learning, world models, generative modeling, and neuro‑symbolic AI, targeting senior undergraduates, graduate students, PhD candidates, faculty, and industry professionals. The school aims to foster collaboration, provide AI research training, and inspire early‑stage researchers from Nepal and the region.

name: EEML Summer School
description: The Eastern European Machine Learning Summer School takes place in Cetinje, Montenegro from 27 July to 1 August 2026. The program offers a series of lectures and tutorials on advanced machine‑learning topics delivered by leading researchers from academia and industry. It is aimed at graduate students and early‑career researchers interested in deep learning, AI research, and networking within the Eastern European ML community.

name: Mediterranean Summer School
description: The Mediterranean Machine Learning (M2L) Summer School provides a focused five‑day program of keynotes, lectures and hands‑on sessions led by AI experts. It is aimed at doctoral and outstanding master students, as well as academics and practitioners, especially from the Mediterranean region, and covers topics such as computer vision, natural language processing, generative models and reinforcement learning. The school also offers poster presentations, scholarships to promote diversity, and networking activities to foster collaboration.

name: Summer School on Multimodal Foundation Models and Generative AI
venue: Institut National des Postes et Télécommunications, Rabat, Morocco
description: The 2nd edition of the AI Summer School on Multimodal Foundation Models and Generative AI takes place at the Institut National des Postes et Télécommunications in Rabat, Morocco. It offers five days of expert lectures, hands‑on labs, and project work aimed at master, Ph.D., post‑doc and early‑career researchers interested in state‑of‑the‑art AI techniques. Participants will also benefit from networking events and mentorship opportunities designed to build the next generation of AI leaders in Morocco.

name: AthNLP Summer School 2026
description: The Athens Natural Language Processing (AthNLP) Summer School 2026 is held at the NCSR Demokritos campus in Athens, Greece. The program offers a week of lectures, tutorials, and hands‑on sessions covering recent advances in NLP, and is organized jointly by several research institutes and universities. It also supports the 14th EETN Conference on Artificial Intelligence (SETN 2026) that follows immediately after the school.

name: Advanced Artificial Intelligence: GenAI & Deep Unsupervised Learning
venue: Lady Margaret Hall, Oxford, United Kingdom
description: The Advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning summer school at Lady Margaret Hall covers generative AI and deep unsupervised learning techniques. It combines theoretical lectures with hands‑on projects on clustering, GANs, self‑supervised and energy‑based models, emphasizing real‑world applications across domains. The programme is aimed at STEM students with intermediate AI/ML experience and is offered both as a residential and an online course.

name: AI4Science Summer School
description: The 2nd Summer School on Advancing Scientific Discovery with AI brings together researchers, PhD students and post‑doctoral scholars in Caen, Normandy, France. It focuses on applying deep‑learning techniques to accelerate scientific research, covering topics such as machine learning for data analysis, AI‑driven experimental design, generative models, and integration of AI with physical simulations. The programme combines lectures with hands‑on Python workshops using libraries like NumPy and PyTorch to give participants practical experience in implementing AI models for scientific problems.

name: LUT Summer School
description: LUT Summer School is a one‑week intensive programme that offers courses on sustainability, climate action, marketing, management, inventive thinking and the intersection of business and technology. It is aimed at bachelor’s and master’s students from any university, combining online instruction with a on‑campus teaching week at the Lappeenranta campus in Finland. The programme includes workshops, group work and a social programme set against the backdrop of Finnish summer nature.

name: 1st Internationa School on the Cognitive, Ethical, and Societal Dimensions of AI - AIces
description: AIces 2026 is the first International School on the Cognitive, Ethical and Societal Dimensions of Artificial Intelligence, held in Porto, Portugal. The program targets graduate and postgraduate students as well as industry practitioners, offering parallel courses, a symposium, and open debates covering cognition, ethics, and society. Participants can attend face‑to‑face sessions, join live online, and later access video recordings for 45 days, fostering multidisciplinary discussion and networking.
